author: DonaldMyTrump
body: Howdy there folks!!! The people running slack have been giving me a screw-job and not giving me an actual answer to my appeal by either telling me that I should talk. I was never given warnings and my understanding is that slack works off of a points system and that warnings must be issued. Jahaj has a personal bias against me and for some reason PieZ and Resipignev have been going along with it. I requested evidence of my rule breaking the day of my slack account getting deactivated and still have yet to receive it.
